steps.name: Report bounded original failure evidence
steps.run:
if [ ! -f tools/report_consumer_inner_failure.py ]; then
  echo '::error title=Original failure reporter::stage=checkout-unavailable'
  exit 1
fi
set +e
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 180s python3 -B tools/report_consumer_inner_failure.py
status=$?
if [ "$status" -eq 124 ] || [ "$status" -eq 137 ]; then
  echo '::error title=Original failure reporter::stage=timeout'
fi
exit "$status"

reviewReason: Authenticate the original failure artifact and emit bounded, source-attributed failure data.
